observations: Photo 0 shows a black Nikon DSLR camera with a lens attached, held in hand. The camera body has 'Nikon' and 'D3400' clearly visible. The lens is labeled 'Nikon AF-P DX NIKKOR 18-55mm 1:3.5-5.6G VR'.
Photo 1 shows the top of the camera with 'Nikon' and 'D3400' visible. The lens barrel has focus and zoom rings with numbers 18, 24, 35, 45, 55 visible.
Photo 2 shows the back of the camera with a label that reads 'Nikon Digital Camera D3400 N151F', 'MADE IN THAILAND', and other regulatory marks. The lens also has 'MADE IN THAILAND' printed on it.
All photos show a watermark 'MCSTEVE POSTED ON JIJI'.
The camera appears to be in used condition with some dust and minor wear visible on the lens and body.

claims.claim: This is a Nikon D3400 DSLR Professional Camera with 18 - 55MM lens
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'Nikon D3400' on the body and 'Nikon AF-P DX NIKKOR 18-55mm' on the lens. Photo 2 confirms the model as D3400.

claims.claim: that is used and still working
claims.evidence: No photo shows the camera powered on or in use. No proof of functionality is visible. The lens appears clean but no internal components or power test is shown.

risks.risk: Camera may not be functional (e.g., shutter, sensor, or lens issues)
risks.proof: A video clip showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and displaying a clear image on the screen.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal damage or scratches not visible in photos
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens glass under bright light, or a video showing the lens being rotated and examined for scratches or haze.

risks.risk: Battery or charger may be missing or non-functional
risks.proof: Photo of the battery and charger included, or a video showing the camera being powered on with battery and charger.
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing battery and charger

risks.risk: Camera may have hidden mechanical issues (e.g., shutter failure, mirror lock-up)
risks.proof: A video showing the camera being operated through full zoom and focus range, with no error messages or stutters.

proof_requests: Video showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and displaying a clear image on the screen.
Close-up photo of the lens glass under bright light to check for scratches or haze.
Photo of the battery and charger included.
Video showing the camera being operated through full zoom and focus range.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
